title: Crestline Credit Card Renewal Reduction — Alignment Services & Plans
content:
**Cardholder renewal reduction.** On the renewal of an expired Alignment Services & Plans month-based plan, a cardholder renewal reduction takes a percentage of the line's plan price off the renewal price. It is read from the customer's Crestline Credit Card account and the late fees posted to it in the last 12 calendar months.

| Customer's Crestline Credit Card account | Late fee posted in the last 12 calendar months | Reduction, as a percentage of the plan price |
|---|---|---|
| Active | none | 5% |
| Active | one or more | 2% |
| No active account | — | 0% |

The reduction is worked out on its own, as a percentage of the plan price, and taken off the renewal price, which is rounded to the nearest cent and never falls below 0.00.

*Hypothetical:* on a plan price of 200.00, 10.00 is taken off for an active account with no late fee in the period, and 4.00 with one.
